testName: Permission Set Group (PSG) Composite Access Aggregation
steps:
1. Open Setup > Users
2. Open test user record "Sales Ops Specialist"
3. Click on Permission Set Group Assignments related list
4. Click "Edit Assignments" and assign group "PSG_Enterprise_Sales_Operations"
5. Click on Save
6. Log in as test user
7. Verify user can access custom object "Territory_Quota__c" and has export permissions on Opportunity reports
